scope: repair only; Opus ran max throughout; no review data included

method.claude: Deduplicate assistant records by message.id. All repeated usage objects agreed. Classify by parentUuid ancestry to explicit user-turn root. Output includes thinking. Price TTL-specific cache writes.
method.muse: Unique messages[].info.id. Classify info.parentID by exact user roots. Output excludes reasoning, so add it for priced output. Do not sum step-finish parts or session totals again.
method.task_only: Original repair plus resumed repair turns. Exclude readiness and harness-check turns.
method.billing: Claude Max API-equivalent and Muse Go provider-reported token cost, neither actual invoice or subscription allocation.
method.timing: Native pause acknowledgments differ between clients. These are estimates, not a common stopwatch. Resumed-only time is also provided.
method.missing_usage: A failed/aborted request may have provider work without reported usage; no estimate is invented.
